title: Model Contract
description: The OpenAI-compatible request/response shape every arm is expected to honor, enforced in practice by LiteLLM. Derived from the real request/response observed against the Groq arm during Phase 0 testing.

model.description: The LiteLLM alias, e.g. 'groq-fast' — never the real provider model string. This indirection is the entire pluggability mechanism.

known_incompatibility: opencode's newer Responses-API request includes 'prompt_cache_key', an OpenAI-only extension field outside this contract's required shape. Groq rejects it outright; the contract itself doesn't guarantee extension fields are handled uniformly across providers. Fixed at the LiteLLM layer via drop_params/additional_drop_params, not by changing this contract — the contract describes the guaranteed shape, not every optional field a specific client might add.
